yt_title: Check... and the QUEEN is gone 🍢 The Skewer #chess
desc:
The black king and queen are on the same diagonal. Bg2+! The king must move, and Bxa8 wins the queen.

This is a SKEWER: attack the more valuable piece, win the one behind it.
